capabilities: Handwrite and sketch on PDF pages with per-point pressure
Erase ink with a boolean eraser that carves strokes away
Select, move, scale, rotate and nudge ink strokes
Store annotations in a sidecar JSON file without modifying the PDF
extras: Early preview build (0.1.2), desktop only, untested on mobile; the author warns users to back up the annotation folder before trusting it with important data. Code was written with DeepSeek Harness. No network requests or telemetry.
motivation: The author built it to close the seam between reading PDFs and taking handwritten notes, keeping ink in the vault next to the notes.
problem: PDF readers only highlight and handwriting lives on tablets, so annotations end up separated from notes as exported screenshots and retyped text.
summary: PDF annotation plugin that lets you handwrite directly on PDF pages with pressure, layers and a boolean eraser, storing ink in sidecar JSON files.
